## Download

Windows 10/11 x64: download **balistic-calculator-wardogs-win-x64.zip**, unzip it and run `Точный бросок.exe`. No installer, Node.js or internet needed.

Already installed? The overlay updates itself: when **↻ Обновить до …** appears in the title bar, click it (or use the tray menu) to restart into the new version.

The EXE is not code-signed: if SmartScreen warns, choose **More info → Run anyway**. Run the game in windowed or borderless mode.

`app-*.zip` and `update.json` are used by the built-in updater; you don't need to download them.
